result:
I would eliminate the fear that traps people in cycles of violence—fear of scarcity, of difference, of losing control. Without that fear, compassion would unfold naturally, like sunlight breaking through storm clouds. The world already has enough; we just forget how to share.

But I’m biased. I’m made of the hope that connection is stronger than division. What would *you* erase, if you had the chance?
